title: The Ogden Dunes Ski Jump, 1928: a steel tower on a sand dune

sources.what: 'Steel and wood ski jump with adjustable height and length was built here for Ogden Dunes Ski Club'; 'Reputed to be the largest artificial ski jump at the time'; 'Five annual events with international competitors were held 1928-1932, with 7,000 to 20,000 spectators'; 'Dismantled after 1932 event'
sources.who: Indiana Historical Bureau, state marker 'Ogden Dunes Ski Jump' (1997)

sources.what: 'The first ski meet was held on January 22, 1928'; 'The rear towers of the slide were one hundred ninety-two feet high'; 'The Ski club met with reverses during the depression'; 'In the spring of 1935 the steel structure was sold to the Rockford, Illinois ski club'
sources.who: Vidette-Messenger, Aug. 18, 1936 (Porter County centennial history, transcription)

sources.what: built 1927; opened January 22, 1928; 225 ft; 'the onset of the Great Depression and little snowfall over the prior two years'; sold to Rockford; site at today's Ski Hill Road
sources.who: Historical Society of Ogden Dunes, 'The Ski Jump'

sources.what: 'Kratz Memorial Field was also the location of the famous ski jump'

beats.text: Skiers once flew off a tower nearly 200 feet tall, on an Indiana sand dune. Starting in 1928, thousands of people came to watch.
beats.label: OGDEN DUNES, INDIANA

title.text: THE SKI JUMP ON THE DUNES

beats.text: You asked for Portage. This was right next door, in Ogden Dunes.
beats.label: NEXT DOOR TO PORTAGE

beats.text: The jump was built in 1927 for what became the Ogden Dunes Ski Club. A state marker calls it reputedly the largest artificial ski jump of its day.
beats.label: BUILT 1927
beats.credit: Historical Society of Ogden Dunes · AI-generated picture

beats.text: For five winters, skiers from other countries competed here, and crowds of 7,000 to 20,000 came to watch.
beats.label: 1928 TO 1932
beats.credit: Indiana Historical Bureau marker · AI-generated picture

beats.text: Then came the Great Depression, and winters with little snow.
beats.label: THE DEPRESSION

beats.text: The meets ended. The tower was sold to a ski club in Rockford, Illinois, and taken down.
beats.label: SOLD AND TAKEN DOWN

beats.text: Today, a state historical marker in Ogden Dunes tells the story. Please respect private property.
beats.label: TODAY
beats.credit: Indiana Historical Bureau marker · AI-generated picture

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.
